verdict.rationale: An in-app AI assistant is a plausible feature for a consumer security app, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only authentication features: passwordless sign-in, OTP codes, push approvals, passkeys, Verified IDs, backup, App Lock and password export. Nothing shows a built-in AI assistant or any way to delegate tasks to one, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
